candidate_decision_scope: Research recommendation only, not CURRENT materialization or download authorization.
replacement_proposal: No immediate removal. Wan-Animate-2 is motion-conditioned, LongCat is audio-conditioned, LivePortrait is lightweight face driving; different control interfaces. SCAIL/LiveAvatar remain alternatives, not automatic extra copies.

candidates.positive_evidence: Author paper reports >70% pairwise preference vs Wan-Animate; dual-branch conditioning, time-aligned RoPE and sparse reference attention remove separate pose extraction.
candidates.negative_evidence: No independent reproduction. Study sample/rater count and evaluation hardware were not established. Selected Base is not the real-time Lite model; all-task viewpoint LoRA support not independently verified. Reference implementation uses multiple A800 GPUs.
candidates.uniqueness_vs_portfolio: Adds full-body driving-video motion transfer rather than only LivePortrait facial driving or generic Wan2.2 TI2V generation.
candidates.license_assessment: Apache-2.0 declared on official weights and Apache LICENSE text read in Wan-Video/Wan-Animate-2; dependency-specific terms and subject consent remain separate.
candidates.next_check: Pin inference implementation and complete support files; compare consented 20 driving sequences against existing LivePortrait where applicable and generic Wan; measure single-system peak RAM/latency.
candidates.reversal_condition: Downgrade if target motions fail, runtime is unusable on available hardware, or a smaller existing model reproduces the same motion and identity retention.
candidates.restriction_scenario: Hypothesis: identity-preserving human synthesis may face earlier distribution scrutiny; no model-specific withdrawal or ban verified.
candidates.total_scope: Complete stored float scalar census: conservative upper bound for the selected learned-weight family, not unique trainable parameter identity.

runtime.reference_hardware: 8 x A800 at 720P; 2 x A800 at 480P; no consumer GPU validation

alternate_source.status: author_linked_original_format; exact revision/file hash parity NOT verified; not assumed mirror of selected Diffusers weights

candidates.positive_evidence: Author study includes 508 image-audio pairs, 770 raters and 13240 judgments plus 10 expert raters; distinctive multi-stream audio conditioning, video continuation and RLHF followed by 8-NFE distillation.
candidates.negative_evidence: Author-organized evaluation, not independent reproduction. The non-accelerated Base retains better human-likeness and lip synchronization; accelerated results reduce distortion. Chinese/English evaluation does not establish Japanese quality. INT8 parity and practical single-GPU speed are unverified.
candidates.uniqueness_vs_portfolio: Conditions on supplied speech to generate one or multiple speaking bodies; does not synthesize new speech. Existing TTS, LivePortrait and generic LTX are not automatically equivalent.
candidates.license_assessment: MIT declared on avatar card; MIT LICENSE text read in official code and parent repository. Avatar repo lacks a separate LICENSE in the inspected listing; preserve provenance and check bundled separator/component notices rather than reject a missing tag.
candidates.next_check: Count the ONNX vocal separator without executing it, freeze support files and exact INT8 loader; test lip sync/identity drift against existing tools using consented Japanese and bilingual examples.
candidates.reversal_condition: Downgrade if INT8 loses lip sync/identity or the runtime cost outweighs the distinct multi-person conditioning value.
candidates.restriction_scenario: Hypothesis: identity-preserving human synthesis may face earlier distribution scrutiny; no model-specific withdrawal or ban verified.
candidates.older_unique_exception_reason: Current author-listed Avatar 1.5; audio-conditioned multi-person capability and published human evaluation not supplied by existing generic video assets. Not included merely for age or popularity.

candidates.positive_evidence: Raw-video driving, character replacement and multi-character conditioning; creator reports 60000 synthetic motion pairs, reverse driving, and a relighting adapter.
candidates.negative_evidence: Overlap with Wan-Animate-2, no matched independent quality comparison found. Main checkpoint is a 65.58GB .pt file; no unsafe deserialization was attempted and total learned components remain unknown.
candidates.uniqueness_vs_portfolio: Potentially valuable replacement/relighting control beyond plain motion transfer; keep as fallback rather than storing both immediately.
candidates.license_assessment: Weight card MIT metadata versus code Apache-2.0 declaration are different scopes, not automatic illegality; exact checkpoint and donor terms require review.
candidates.next_check: Compare replacement and relighting against Wan using identical clips; inspect safe metadata/export for complete total.
candidates.reversal_condition: Promote only if replacement/relighting gains are reproducible and justify duplicate foundation weights.
candidates.restriction_scenario: Hypothesis: identity-preserving human synthesis may face earlier distribution scrutiny; no model-specific withdrawal or ban verified.

candidates.positive_evidence: Distinct 4-step streaming LoRA; author describes long-duration autoregressive streaming and subsequent FP8 runtime support.
candidates.negative_evidence: Adapter-only 1.353GB does not include Wan2.2-S2V-14B or its dependencies. Reported 45fps uses a multi-H800 system, not a consumer GPU. Compared local quality and full costs unknown.
candidates.uniqueness_vs_portfolio: Streaming continuity could complement offline LongCat; not a direct TTS or LivePortrait replacement.
candidates.license_assessment: Apache-2.0 declared for project and Wan base; complete downstream/runtime rights still separate.
candidates.next_check: Verify base dependency set and long-horizon quality, then test FP8 on available hardware rather than import multi-H800 speed.
candidates.reversal_condition: Promote only if required long-stream behavior is absent in selected models and the full cost is practical.
candidates.restriction_scenario: Hypothesis: identity-preserving human synthesis may face earlier distribution scrutiny; no model-specific withdrawal or ban verified.

candidates.negative_evidence: Very different hardware from user machine; batch, clock and independent practical quality not established. Full Ovi-related dependencies and parameter total unverified.
candidates.uniqueness_vs_portfolio: Joint speech generation is distinct from LongCat, which consumes supplied audio, but costly and unproven for intended hardware.
candidates.license_assessment: MIT metadata/code declaration; complete parent Ovi/codec dependencies require review.
candidates.next_check: Identify full joint audio-video decoder bundle and compare Japanese speech quality and latency with separate TTS plus avatar.
candidates.reversal_condition: Promote if joint generation materially outperforms a modular pipeline within actual resource limits.
candidates.restriction_scenario: Hypothesis: identity-preserving human synthesis may face earlier distribution scrutiny; no model-specific withdrawal or ban verified.

candidates.positive_evidence: Dual speech/listening motion generator can reuse a LivePortrait-derived renderer; producer table lists 166ms per five-frame chunk on RTX4060Ti.
candidates.negative_evidence: No independent image/lip-sync benchmark; table trial count, clock and VRAM unknown, and a later card note refers to A100-only measurement. Full renderer/InsightFace/engine dependency count unknown. Gated access not accepted.

candidates.next_check: Review actual model LICENSE/third-party notices via normal gate process; confirm exact renderer dependencies, consumer measurement conditions and portrait consent.
candidates.reversal_condition: Promote only after quality and lightweight distinct behavior are validated without silently accepting gated terms.
